title: Redwire Co-Hosts Youth Football Clinic for Military Families with Washington Commanders

body_markdown:
Supporting the U.S. armed forces and giving back to our communities is another way Redwire is *Made for the Mission* , and Redwire volunteers recently put that ethos into action. As a **Proud Drone Technology Partner** of the Washington Commanders, Redwire co-hosted a community event on October 22 that invited **kids from military families to participate in a youth football clinic alongside Commanders’ coaches and staff.**


Credit: Washington Commanders Credit: Washington Commanders


The football clinic was held at **Marine Corps Base Quantico** south of Washington, D.C. and drew approximately 350 attendees, including over **200 youth participants** who rotated through multiple stations designed to teach football fundamentals and foster teamwork.


Credit: Washington Commanders Credit: Washington Commanders


Youth athletes also had the chance to meet the **Commanders’ team dog, TJ** —[a service dog in training](https://www.commanders.com/news/commanders-welcome-team-dog-partnership-redwire) who will eventually support a veteran through a partnership with Redwire and Warrior Canine Connection.


Credit: Washington Commanders


Redwire is proud of the volunteers from our team who made this evening a memorable event for military families, and even prouder to serve those who serve our nation.


Redwire leadership and employees volunteer at Touching Base Tour football clinic for military youth


**Learn more about Redwire’s multi-year partnership with the Washington Commanders at**[RDW.com](https://rdw.com/newsroom/redwire-becomes-proud-drone-technology-partner-of-the-washington-commanders-to-showcase-military-appreciation/) **.**
